condition_observed: Raw ignition pixel (row 538, col 872) has FBFM40 code 91 (91 Developed / Non-fuel). Snapped to nearest burnable pixel (row 535, col 869) with FBFM40 code 145 (102 GR2 Low Load Dry Grass).
engine_impact: If unsnapped, Cell2Fire treats cell as NF (code 101) and aborts immediately with 0 burned cells. Snapping successfully enabled ignition.

condition_observed: Cell2Fire C++ binary strictly implements the 18 Canadian Forest Fire Behavior Prediction (FBP) fuel types (C1-C7, D1-D2, M1-M4, S1-S3, O1a-O1b). It does NOT implement the US Scott & Burgan 40 Rothermel fuel models.
engine_impact: Required heuristic crosswalk (e.g. FBFM 145 SH5 -> C-7 Ponderosa; TL5 -> C-5). Distorts physical spread rates and moisture-of-extinction dynamics.

condition_observed: In Canadian FBP, grass models O-1a/O-1b require explicit grass fuel load (gfl) in Data.csv. Defaulting gfl to 0.0 results in 0.0 surface fuel consumption and 0.0 rate of spread.
engine_impact: Resolved by explicitly injecting gfl = 0.35 kg/m2 into Data.csv for all grass pixels.

condition_observed: Cell2Fire expects wind speed in km/h (not m/s or mph), direction in degrees from North (meteorological azimuth, 0-360), and hourly rows in Weather.csv with FFMC, ISI, BUI.
engine_impact: HRRR 10m wind speeds were properly converted (m/s * 3.6 -> km/h) and direction converted to meteorological azimuth. Weather format fully valid.

engine_impact: Without ember spotting across non-burnable cells, spread cannot propagate out of the canyon. Observed fire burned 22,000 ha in 12h; Cell2Fire burned 32.8 ha.
